name: contact-barrier-a15
label: Chart
claim_label: Model output: gated surface scores of traces on PHerc0139 against its published windings; one sector, five windings, two repeats
alt: Two grouped bar charts. Left, area on the seeded winding: all three arms cover similar area, 0.1 to 0.43 cm2 per winding; the contact barrier arm is marked pass on w051 and w055. Right, area on other windings (lower is better): orange and green bars reach up to 5.4 and 7.9 cm2, the blue contact barrier bars stay at 0.00 to 0.03 cm2.
caption: Held-out comparison on PHerc0139 (report windings w049 to w058, z 5248 to 5760), frozen rule, two repeats, 22 October 2026. The contact barrier arm passed 2 of 5 windings in both repeats and villa's stock tracer 0 of 5. Model output: traced geometry scored against the published windings, no ink.

data.credit: Scores from a frozen held-out test run on 22 October 2026; the windings are the published PHerc0139 meshes of the Vesuvius Challenge open data, CC BY-NC 4.0 (no scan pixels in the chart)
